data.description: Blocks and items made with MCSuperMods.
data.name: MSM Examples

meta.notes: One per project: it becomes fabric.mod.json in the Fabric mod jar. mod_id names the mod to Fabric and must be unique among installed mods: a lower-case letter, then letters, digits, _ or -. version is shown in the mod list; raise it with each release. Without this element the jar gets a mod id derived from the project name.
